questions.question: What was Moses and Aaron's first request to Pharaoh?
options: To lighten the heavy burdens laid on the Hebrew people
To let Israel go and hold a feast in the wilderness
To grant the Hebrews a portion of land in Goshen
To free every Hebrew slave throughout Egypt at once
questions.answer: To let Israel go and hold a feast in the wilderness

questions.question: How did Pharaoh respond to their request?
options: He offered them land if they would stay
He agreed to let them go after one day
He made the work harder, bricks without straw
He had Moses thrown into an Egyptian prison
questions.answer: He made the work harder, bricks without straw

questions.question: Pharaoh said he did not know the LORD and would not let Israel go.
